current_difficulty_reason: The ordinary minimum-action argument only gives a linear Calabi bound and does not supply the strict quadratic improvement at a degenerating boundary. Section2 constructs an adapted Weinstein graph model and a quasi-autonomous generating isotopy with uniform quadratic boundary behavior. Integrating its sharp collar lower bound produces the quadratic action term and the equality characterization, which remain required after standard Hamiltonian foundations are allowed.
